#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the compiler toolchain: bytecode-compile the compiler and prepare build/.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

command -v gcc >/dev/null || {
    echo "error: gcc is required to assemble and link test programs" >&2
    exit 1
}

mkdir -p build

# Bytecode-compile so syntax/import errors surface here rather than at test time.
PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=build/pycache python3 -m py_compile src/compiler.py tools/snapshot.py
chmod +x src/compiler.py test.sh tools/snapshot.py

echo "Build OK (src/compiler.py, tools/snapshot.py)"
